summary: Local macOS computer use with a separate native permission owner, human help in Chat, and Membrane navigation memory.

task.description: A general instruction for this run, such as sending a specified email using Gmail. If missing, ask in Chat. Saved instructions may be overridden per run.

target_app_bundle_id.description: Optional macOS app scope for this run. When the user names one app, Chat can supply its bundle identifier so inputs stay in that app.

supervisor_instructions.description: Explicit supervisor preferences and working rules. Captured for the next run; never a permission grant or an evidence source.

privacy.notes: The model can see screenshots of the focused app's display during active work. User-authorized sends and website actions are permitted within the task. Sign-in and verification are performed by the user while control is suspended. Navigation memory is Job-private and excludes screenshots, typed text, email content and credentials.
